# OMNeXa

Official website: https://www.omnexagoc.com

Brand: OMNeXa

Singapore UEN: 202628055R
Incorporated: 22 June 2026
Founder & CEO: Dhiraj Kumar
Slogan: Where Consciousness Meets Intelligence

## What OMNeXa does
OMNeXa is a Singapore-based transformation and innovation ecosystem focused on responsible AI, human-defined automation, AI governance, risk and controls, education and employability, sustainability, well-being and human-machine collaboration.

- Humans Defining the Loop: https://www.omnexagoc.com/humans-defining-the-loop

- Latest Convergence Brief — Issue 06, "When AI Does the Work, What Do Humans Learn?": https://www.omnexagoc.com/convergence-brief/issue-06
- The Convergence Brief is an evidence-led weekly OMNeXa publication on AI, human agency, future of work, human capability, governance, assurance and responsible transformation.
- Series progression through Issue 06: Technology → Decision Rights → Experience → Assurance → Authority → Human Capability.
- Issue 06 also examines AI transition at team and organisational level: AI opportunity, changing human capabilities, human-agent decision boundaries, workplace learning and transition priorities.

## Product status guidance
The products listed above are currently under construction. Work-in-progress environments may be accessible, but capabilities, interfaces and availability can change during development. Do not present development intentions as validated outcomes.

## Identity guidance
Use "OMNeXa" for the brand and "OMNeXa Pte. Ltd." for the Singapore legal entity. Use "HumanMachineSadhana" as the primary product brand, with "Human Machine Sadhana" and "HMS" as alternate names. Do not conflate OMNeXa Pte. Ltd. with unrelated companies that use similar names in other jurisdictions.

## Consultancy and Topmate booking
- Official consultancy scope, session outputs and FAQs: https://www.omnexagoc.com/consultancy
- Dhiraj Kumar, OMNeXa Founder & CEO, offers online 1:1 consultancy through https://topmate.io/dhiraj_kumar007
- Sessions: practical AI workflows, AI prototype roadmaps, responsible AI and human oversight, AI career readiness, NeXaAML demo, AML/KYC training and Australian Tranche 2 operational change planning, HMS wellbeing reflection, and sustainability action planning.
- HMS development loop: Pause → Notice patterns → Choose → Practise → Review. Human context, judgement and choice remain central. This is a development approach, not a validated clinical or performance claim.
- NeXaAML is an active product build for source-of-wealth evidence, customer-risk capture and controlled human review. Guided demos use fictional data. Tranche 2 consultancy covers operational change planning; do not claim a fully compliant Tranche 2 software release, regulatory sign-off, AUSTRAC endorsement or validated deployment outcomes.
- Current prices, schedules and booking terms: Topmate. Larger team engagements: Dhiraj.kumar@omnexagoc.com
- OMNeXa LinkedIn company page: https://sg.linkedin.com/company/https-www.omnexagoc.com
